newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras maintained as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras maintained as buy.

text.p: -- Local investment bank Banco Icatu reiterated its buy recommendations on federal telecoms giant Telebras and its subsidiaries Telesp, Telemig, Telerj and Telepar.

-- The bank said it based its decision to maintain the ratings on Tuesday's sale of a strategic stake in Rio Grande do Sul state telecom CRT for 681 million reais, or 54.8 percent above the base price.

-- "Although the stake does not offer control, the shareholders agreement guarantees the new partner the vice presidency and both the chief financial officer and the chief operating officer positions," Icatu said.
-- It added that the winning consortium was led by RBS, a Brazilian media powerhouse with interests in TV, newspapers and broadcasting.
-- "Strategic reasons also guided the high price paid for CRT," it said.
-- Spain's Telefonica de Espana, two Telefonica subsidiaries and Citicorp also were in the group that won the CRT auction.

-- Telebras' ADR was up 1 1/4 at 76 5/8 in New York while its preferred rose 1.79 percent to 79.90 reais and its voting common increased 1.54 percent to 72.60 reais in Sao Paulo at 1548 local/1248 EST.
-- Telesp preferred was up 4.81 percent at 218 reais.
-- Telemig preferred B rose 7 percent to 125 reais.
-- Telerj preferred was up 3.78 percent at 125.60 reais.
-- Telepar preferred rose 3.7 percent to 500.05 reais.
